description_en: Queries the details of a task by task ID, or by resource information and task category
description_zh: 根据任务 ID，或根据资源信息和任务类别查询任务详情
name: GetTask

parameters.help_en: The task ID. If you specify this parameter, the system queries the task by this ID, and the resource information query conditions are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID。传入后优先按该 ID 查询，资源信息查询条件不再参与定位
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The associated resource ID. If you do not specify TaskId, you must specify EntityId, EntityType, and TaskCategory at the same time. The resource ID must match the selected resource type
parameters.help_zh: 关联资源 ID。未传 TaskId 时，必须同时提供 EntityId、EntityType 和 TaskCategory。资源 ID 必须与所选资源类型一致
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The associated resource version ID. This parameter is used to specify the version when you query by resource. For image resources, specify the image version ID
parameters.help_zh: 关联资源版本 ID。在按资源查询时用于限定版本；镜像资源填写镜像版本 ID
parameters.name: entity_version_id

parameters.help_en:
The associated resource type. This parameter is required if you do not specify TaskId.

Valid values:
IMAGE: Image resource.
APP: Application resource.
SNAPSHOT: Snapshot resource.

You must also specify a valid TaskCategory. The resource type itself does not mean that all task categories can be queried by resource
parameters.help_zh:
关联资源类型。未传 TaskId 时必填。

IMAGE：镜像资源。
APP：应用资源。
SNAPSHOT：快照资源。

还须同时选择适用的 TaskCategory，资源类型本身不代表所有任务类别均可按资源查询
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
Not enabled. Do not specify this parameter. When you query a task, locate the task by using TaskId or the combination of resource information and TaskCategory. This parameter is not used for task filtering.

The example "Not applicable (not enabled)" is only a description of the field status and is not a valid parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
尚未启用，请勿传入。 查询任务时，请通过 TaskId 或资源信息与 TaskCategory 定位任务；本参数不参与任务筛选。

示例“不适用（尚未启用）”仅为字段状态说明，不是可传入的参数值
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The task category when you query by resource. This parameter is required if you do not specify TaskId.

Valid values:
IMAGE_BUILDER: Image creation. Queries tasks for manual creation, automatic creation, or creation based on an instance.
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE: Image distribution across regions
parameters.help_zh:
按资源查询时的任务类别。未传 TaskId 时必填。

IMAGE_BUILDER：镜像制作，查询手动制作、自动制作或基于实例制作的任务。
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE：镜像地域分发任务
parameters.name: task_category

schema.description_en: The response of this API invocation
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this parameter
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
AliUid.description_zh: 资源所属的阿里云账号 ID

CurrentTaskMessage.description_en: The prompt or execution result description of the current task step
CurrentTaskMessage.description_zh: 任务当前步骤的提示或执行结果说明

CurrentTaskStep.description_en: The identifier of the step that the task is currently executing. You can call the ListTaskStep operation to query the image creation and application adaptation steps
CurrentTaskStep.description_zh: 任务当前执行的步骤标识。镜像制作和应用适配步骤可调用 ListTaskStep 查询

ExecuteRegion.description_en: The ID of the region where the task is actually executed
ExecuteRegion.description_zh: 任务实际执行地域 ID

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format, accurate to milliseconds, and the time zone offset is +00:00
GmtCreate.description_zh: 任务创建时间。ISO 8601 格式，精确到毫秒，时区偏移为 +00:00

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the task was last updated. The time is in ISO 8601 format, accurate to milliseconds, and the time zone offset is +00:00
GmtModified.description_zh: 任务最近修改时间。ISO 8601 格式，精确到毫秒，时区偏移为 +00:00

PerformanceType.description_en:
The compute type of the task creation resource.

Valid values:
CPU: CPU compute resource.
GPU: GPU compute resource
PerformanceType.description_zh:
任务制作资源的计算类型。

CPU：CPU 计算资源。
GPU：GPU 计算资源

Progress.description_en:
Not enabled. The system does not return valid task progress. Determine the task execution status based on Status, CurrentTaskStep, and TaskStepList.

The example "Not applicable (not enabled)" is only a description of the field status and is not an actual API response example
Progress.description_zh:
尚未启用，当前不返回有效的任务进度。 请结合 Status、CurrentTaskStep 和 TaskStepList 判断任务执行情况。

示例“不适用（尚未启用）”仅为字段状态说明，不是实际 API 返回样例

ResourceList.description_en: The list of resources used for task creation, which corresponds to the creation resources submitted when the task is created
ResourceList.description_zh: 任务制作所使用的资源列表，与创建任务时提交的制作资源相对应

Resource.description_en: The resource content corresponding to ResourceType. For the URL type, specify or return an accessible resource address
Resource.description_zh: 与 ResourceType 对应的资源内容。URL 类型填写或返回可访问的资源地址

ResourceType.description_en:
The provision method of the resource content.

Valid values:
HOSTED: Hosted resource.
TEXT: Text resource.
URL: Resource provided through a URL
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源内容的提供方式。可选值：

HOSTED：托管资源。
TEXT：文本资源。
URL：通过 URL 提供的资源

RunMode.description_en:
The running mode of the task creation environment.

Valid values:
NORMAL: Normal running mode.
COMPATIBLE: Compatible running mode
RunMode.description_zh:
任务制作环境的运行模式。可选值：

NORMAL：普通运行模式。
COMPATIBLE：兼容运行模式

Status.description_en:
The overall status of the task.

Valid values:
INIT: The task is initialized.
START: The task is being created or executed.
SUCCESS: The task is executed successfully.
FAILED: The task fails to be executed.
DELETED: The task is deleted.

Deleted tasks are not included in the regular valid task query scope
Status.description_zh:
任务整体状态。

INIT：任务已初始化。
START：任务正在制作或执行。
SUCCESS：任务执行成功。
FAILED：任务执行失败。
DELETED：任务已删除。

已删除任务不在常规有效任务查询范围内

SystemDiskSize.description_en: The capacity of the system cloud disk in the task creation environment. Unit: GiB
SystemDiskSize.description_zh: 任务制作环境的系统盘容量。单位：GiB

SystemImageId.description_en: The ID of the base system image used in the task creation environment
SystemImageId.description_zh: 任务制作环境所使用的基础系统镜像 ID

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. You can use this ID to call the GetTask operation to query the task status
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，可用于调用 GetTask 查询任务状态

TaskStepList.description_en: The list of recorded task execution steps and results
TaskStepList.description_zh: 已记录的任务执行步骤及结果列表

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the step. It is a UNIX timestamp calculated from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter may not be returned if the step has not ended
EndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间，为从 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 起计算的 Unix 时间戳。单位：毫秒。尚未结束时可能不返回

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the step. It is a UNIX timestamp calculated from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间，为从 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 起计算的 Unix 时间戳。单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the step.

Valid values:
RUNNING: The step is executing.
SUCCESS: The step is executed successfully.
FAILED: The step fails to be executed
Status.description_zh:
步骤执行状态。

RUNNING：步骤正在执行。
SUCCESS：步骤执行成功。
FAILED：步骤执行失败

StepEndTime.description_en: The end time of the step in ISO 8601 format, including the time zone offset. In the example, +08:00 indicates UTC+8. This parameter represents the same time as EndTime and is parsed based on the offset in the return value. This parameter may not be returned if the step has not ended
StepEndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间的 ISO 8601 字符串，包含时区偏移；示例中的 +08:00 表示东八区。与 EndTime 表示同一时刻，按返回值中的偏移解析。尚未结束时可能不返回

StepStartTime.description_en: The start time of the step in ISO 8601 format, including the time zone offset. In the example, +08:00 indicates UTC+8. This parameter represents the same time as StartTime and is parsed based on the offset in the return value
StepStartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间的 ISO 8601 字符串，包含时区偏移；示例中的 +08:00 表示东八区。与 StartTime 表示同一时刻，按返回值中的偏移解析

TaskMessage.description_en: The prompt or execution result description of this step
TaskMessage.description_zh: 该步骤的提示或执行结果说明

TaskStep.description_en: The task step identifier corresponding to this record. You can call the ListTaskStep operation to query the image creation and application adaptation steps
TaskStep.description_zh: 该记录对应的任务步骤标识。镜像制作和应用适配步骤可调用 ListTaskStep 查询

TaskType.description_en:
The actual type of the task.

Valid values:
AUTO_ADAPT: Automatic adaptation.
AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE: Automatic image creation.
RETRY_ADAPT: Retry automatic adaptation.
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE: Retry automatic image creation.
AUTO_OTA_IMAGE: Automatic image OTA.
AUTO_CREATE_VHD: Automatic VHD creation.
RETRY_VHD: Retry VHD creation.
AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD: Automatic VHD image creation.
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD: Retry VHD image creation.
AUTO_VALIDATE_VHD: Automatic VHD validation.
RETRY_VALIDATE_VHD: Retry VHD validation.
SYNCHRONIZE_APP_IMAGE: Synchronize application image.
APPLY_VHD_BUILDER: Apply for VHD application recording environment.
RETRY_VHD_BUILDER: Retry applying for VHD recording environment.
ADAPT_AUTO: Automatic application adaptation creation.
ADAPT_AUTO_RETRY: Retry automatic application adaptation creation.
ADAPT_MANUAL: Manual application adaptation creation.
ADAPT_MANUAL_RETRY: Retry manual application adaptation creation.
IMAGE_AUTO: Automatic image creation.
IMAGE_AUTO_RETRY: Retry automatic image creation.
IMAGE_AUTO_VALIDATE: Automatic image validation.
IMAGE_AUTO_VALIDATE_RETRY: Retry automatic image validation.
IMAGE_MANUAL: Manual image creation.
IMAGE_MANUAL_RETRY: Retry manual image creation.
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE: Create cloud desktop custom image.
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE_RETRY: Retry creating cloud desktop custom image.
DESKTOP_SYNC_IMAGE: Synchronize cloud desktop image across regions.
DESKTOP_SYNC_IMAGE_RETRY: Retry synchronizing cloud desktop image across regions.
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE: Distribute image to multiple regions.
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY: Retry image distribution.
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE: Create image based on instance.
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE_RETRY: Retry creating image based on instance.
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE: Distribute snapshot to multiple regions.
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY: Retry snapshot distribution.
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK: Create snapshot based on disk.
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK_RETRY: Retry creating snapshot based on disk.
IMAGE_CLEAN_AND_CREATE: Create temporary instance based on image, clean it, and create final image.
IMAGE_CLEAN_AND_CREATE_RETRY: Retry creating final image after cleaning
TaskType.description_zh:
任务实际类型。

可选值：

AUTO_ADAPT：自动化适配。
AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE：自动制作镜像。
RETRY_ADAPT：重试自动化适配。
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE：重试自动制作镜像。
AUTO_OTA_IMAGE：自动执行镜像 OTA。
AUTO_CREATE_VHD：自动制作 VHD。
RETRY_VHD：重试 VHD 制作。
AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD：自动制作 VHD 镜像。
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD：重试 VHD 镜像制作。
AUTO_VALIDATE_VHD：自动验证 VHD。
RETRY_VALIDATE_VHD：重试 VHD 验证。
SYNCHRONIZE_APP_IMAGE：同步应用镜像。
APPLY_VHD_BUILDER：申请 VHD 应用录制环境。
RETRY_VHD_BUILDER：重试申请 VHD 录制环境。
ADAPT_AUTO：自动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_AUTO_RETRY：重试自动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_MANUAL：手动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_MANUAL_RETRY：重试手动制作应用适配。
IMAGE_AUTO：自动制作镜像。
IMAGE_AUTO_RETRY：重试自动制作镜像。
IMAGE_AUTO_VALIDATE：自动验证镜像。
IMAGE_AUTO_VALIDATE_RETRY：重试自动验证镜像。
IMAGE_MANUAL：手动制作镜像。
IMAGE_MANUAL_RETRY：重试手动制作镜像。
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE：创建云电脑自定义镜像。
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE_RETRY：重试创建云电脑自定义镜像。
DESKTOP_SYNC_IMAGE：跨地域同步云电脑镜像。
DESKTOP_SYNC_IMAGE_RETRY：重试跨地域同步云电脑镜像。
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE：向多个地域分发镜像。
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY：重试镜像分发。
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE：基于实例制作镜像。
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE_RETRY：重试基于实例制作镜像。
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE：向多个地域分发快照。
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY：重试快照分发。
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK：基于磁盘创建快照。
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK_RETRY：重试基于磁盘创建快照。
IMAGE_CLEAN_AND_CREATE：基于镜像创建临时实例，完成清理后制作最终镜像。
IMAGE_CLEAN_AND_CREATE_RETRY：重试清理后制作最终镜像

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This parameter describes the cause when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this parameter
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, you must query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
